::: {#bdbe399f .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe

import aerosandbox.tools.pretty_plots as p

# Geometric properties of the reconstructed airframe
b_w = wing.span()
S_w = wing.area()
c_mac = wing.mean_aerodynamic_chord()
taper_w = c_tip_wing / c_root_wing
l_fuse = fuse.length()
S_wet_fuse = fuse.area_wetted()
n_fuse_xsecs = len(fuse.xsecs)
b_h = htail.span()
S_h = htail.area()
b_v = vtail.span()
S_v = vtail.area()
```
:::


**Answer.** The reconstructed airframe reproduces the semi-scale layout of a P-51 Mustang with a low-wing tractor configuration (@fig-reconstructed-three-view). The tapered wing spans [623 mm]{.key} with [6\.85 dm²]{.key} planform area, a taper ratio of [0\.65]{.key}, and [2\.5°]{.key} dihedral. The [482 mm]{.key} fuselage features [8]{.key} cross-section stations capturing the radiator belly scoop and canopy deck, totaling [8\.67 dm²]{.key} wetted area. The conventional empennage mounts a [213 mm]{.key} horizontal stabilizer and an [88 mm]{.key} vertical fin.
